2607.29181.title: SERUM: State Extraction and Refinement for User Modeling
2607.29181.paper_summary: Agentic assistants capable of proactive, personalized interactions require structured models of user intent and workflow. However, building these models from raw, unstructured screen activity remains an open challenge. We present SERUM, a multi-pass framework that extracts finite-state behavioral models directly from unstructured egocentric video using hierarchical VLM annotation. Processing screen recordings through a sliding window, SERUM alternates between activity-recognition and intent-inference passes, with each pass refining labels using accumulated prior context to reduce hallucination and temporal conflation seen in single-pass annotation. Synonymous states are then merged via sentence embeddings and human-calibrated thresholds into a compact, coherent taxonomy. We evaluate behavioral structure by fitting first-order Markov models over the resulting label sequences (both actions and intents) and measuring predictive accuracy against frequency baselines. Across 61 egocentric videos in four domains (coding, cooking, physical activities, and daily life), we find: (1) iterative label refinement converges to a stable state vocabulary, which we term schematic equilibrium, after several passes; (2) normalized Markov models achieve substantially lower perplexity and higher action predictions than frequency baselines, with the largest gains on structured tasks like coding; and (3) human annotators rate final-pass labels as accurate and meaningfully improved over first-pass labels. To our knowledge, SERUM is the first system to produce interpretable process models from unstructured egocentric screen video without manual annotation, opening a scalable pathway for user modeling and behavioral understanding in the wild. Our demo, code, and results are publicly available
2607.29181.paper_summary_zh: 能夠主動進行個性化互動的代理助手需要用戶意圖和工作流程的結構化模型。<lb/>然而，從原始的非結構化螢幕活動中構建這些模型仍然是一個未解決的挑戰。<lb/>我們提出了SERUM，一個多次通過的框架，直接從非結構化的自我中心視頻中提取有限狀態行為模型，使用層級VLM標註。<lb/>通過滑動窗口處理螢幕錄像，SERUM在活動識別和意圖推斷通過之間交替進行，每次通過使用累積的先前上下文來細化標籤，以減少在單次通過標註中出現的幻覺和時間混淆。<lb/>然後，通過句子嵌入和人為校準的閾值將同義狀態合併成一個緊湊且一致的分類法。<lb/>我們通過對結果標籤序列（包括行為和意圖）擬合一階馬可夫模型來評估行為結構，並測量與頻率基準的預測準確性。<lb/>在四個領域（編程、烹飪、體育活動和日常生活）中的61個自我中心視頻中，我們發現：（1）迭代標籤細化在幾次通過後收斂到穩定的狀態詞彙，我們稱之為示意平衡；（2）正規化的馬可夫模型實現了顯著較低的困惑度和較高的行為預測準確性，尤其在像編程這樣的結構化任務中獲得了最大的提升；（3）人類標註者評價最終通過的標籤準確且在意義上優於第一次通過的標籤。<lb/>據我們所知，SERUM是第一個能夠從非結構化自我中心螢幕視頻中生成可解釋的過程模型而無需手動標註的系統，為用戶建模和行為理解開辟了一條可擴展的途徑。<lb/>我們的演示、代碼和結果均可公開獲取。
